preserved_behaviors: First list item owns a section activation; siblings and nested story paragraphs do not consume it.
Tables carry their section style without a blank paragraph. Frames use a styled containing paragraph; nested controls pass activation to first supported content.
Equal continuous page geometry and stories reuse their master; changed geometry or stories retain their own master.
Main-body notes retain ownership when comments/headers contain earlier references.
Internal anchors, file URLs and web URLs survive, and bookmarks emit both boundaries.
